messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted weird drops in batch_utilization for the continuous batcher on promo-serve models over the past 6h. Need a quick telemetry checklist and a small dashboard to triage.
alex: Can you paste the rough time range and any correlating deploys?
maria: 2025-11-06T02:10:00Z -> 2025-11-06T08:30:00Z. infra-bot shows a runtime-side change around 02:05 (kernel selector tweak).
infra-bot: deploy: runtime-kernel-selector v3.14 deployed to us-west-2 at 2025-11-06T02:04:12Z — sha: a1b2c3d — change: prefer-v2kernels for long-context models.
ken: That matches. Early hypothesis: selector favored a kernel variant that increases per-token latency for short prefixes, which may reduce batching headroom and lower utilization.
olivia: For telemetry, we should capture: `batch_utilization`, `avg_batch_size`, `queue_depth_p50/p95`, `tokens_per_sec`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`, and `model_kernel_variant` tag. Also sampling of `latency_by_seq_len`.
alex: Agreed. Add `sampled_request_trace` at 1% for affected models to see prefix lengths and routing.
maria: Draft PromQL queries for panels: 
```
# batch utilization (percent)
sum(rate(batch_tokens{service="cont-batcher"}[5m])) / sum(rate(token_budget_target{service="cont-batcher"}[5m])) * 100

# avg batch size
avg_over_time(batch_size{pool="promo-serve"}[5m])

# queue depth p95
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(queue_depth_bucket{job="cont-batcher"}[5m])) by (le))
```

ken: Looks good. For tokens/sec we should break out by `kernel_variant` label: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (kernel_variant, model)
```

olivia: Also want an annotation when kernel-selector rolls happen (deploys) and when quantization profile changes. infra-bot can push those as events.
infra-bot: event: quant-profile-update for model-gtx7 at 2025-11-05T23:12:09Z
sam: For alerts: fire when `batch_utilization < 30%` for 10m AND `queue_depth_p95 < 2` — indicates underutilized due to routing/latency. Another alert for `tokens_per_sec` drop > 40% relative to 1h baseline.
maria: Good. Two UX asks: 1) show a small stacked heatmap of `avg_batch_size by seq_len_bucket` so we can see if shorter prefixes cause smaller batches; 2) link to a pinned set of sampled traces for quick inspection.
alex: I'll wire panels into a temporary grafana row and add the heatmap. Can someone own the sampled trace collection?
ken: I'll add an endpoint in cont-batcher to log minimal trace (model, seq_len, kernel_variant, selected_queue, latency_ms) to internal trace store at 0.5% sampling for the promo pool.
olivia: After data starts flowing, schedule a 20-min triage at 11:00 PT. Goal: confirm whether kernel selector change is root cause or if KV cache behavior (hit rate drop) is shrinking effective token budgets.
maria: Assignments: alex — grafana panels + alerts; ken — trace sampler + minimal schema; olivia — triage facilitator + sample-runbook; sam — alert tuning and runbook steps. I'll put the dashboard link in #eng-runtime once ready. :thumbsup:
alex: quick note — panel queries will include `rate` windows 1m/5m to surface short regressions. I'll tag dashboards with `investigation/1755000001`.
ken: implemented sampler PR ready: https://git.redwood/cont-batcher/pull/492 (wip, needs review).
maria: thanks — let's reconvene after the 11:00 PT triage. If alerts trip before then, ping on-call.
olivia: ack.
sam: adding synthetic replay job to simulate high-prefix short-seq traffic to validate batch formation under new kernel. Job scheduled at 09:30 PT.
maria: perfect — records for the triage will be in the dashboard. Closing for now, will post updates. :white_check_mark:
